Citation chip

The most repeated object in the product, so it carries the most weight. Layer colour on the left edge, number in monospace, source id muted. Colour reads before the number does.

Changed 2026-09-14, at the product owner's request

In answer prose, list rows and table rows the boxed chip below is replaced by a superscript marker: the number alone, mono 11px bold in the layer colour (the layer badge's .n rule). One to three sources read as a comma list; four or more collapse to one marker, a range such as 1–13 when consecutive. Hover, keyboard focus or tap opens a small card (the persona info card's shape) with the source name, its id, the layer in words and the record link, host-allowlisted. The full source cards stay in Sources below the answer.

Why: "the inline citations overwhelm the answer". A summary sentence carried up to thirteen chips, so the chips took more room than the words. The chip below remains the record of the original design; it is no longer the inline rendering. Implementation: frontend/src/components/answer/CitationMarkers.tsx. The same change shortened the Write caption to "is writing the answer" followed by an animated ellipsis.

BRCA1 is associated with hereditary breast and ovarian cancer syndrome1. Biallelic variants have also been reported in Fanconi anemia complementation group S3.
